page.overview:
Who is Maduin?

Maduin is an esper and a temporary playable character in Final Fantasy VI. He is the guardian of the Esper World, overseeing the gateway between the esper realm and the realm of humans. The party acquires his magicite to learn spells from.

Maduin is obtained upon completion of the Magitek Research Facility.

Maduin is a humanoid two-horned esper with a muscular figure, dark skin, and a long hair ponytail. He wears a pendant he gives to Madeline when they meet. His field sprite depicts him with light gamboge skin, long sea-greenish-gray hair in a ponytail and indigo eyes. His loincloth changes depending on the version.

His summon sprite depicts him with a grayish-tangelo skin tone, grayish-violet hair in a ponytail and clawed fingers and digitigrade legs with long talons on his toes. He wears a dark vermilion loincloth with an amber sash. His summon sprite resembles that of the Gigas from Final Fantasy V, and may be a heavily modified Gigas sprite.
